title: Hollywood Sign and Coast 35-Minute Helicopter Tour in Los Angeles
includes: Tips/Gratuity - it is customary to tip your pilot (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
For safety reasons, the helicopter cannot accommodate any passengers weighing more than 300 pounds (136 kilos) however if any passenger is over 250 lbs please contact operator.
All flight times are approximate and subject to change due to weather conditions and weight restrictions
All passenger heights and weights must be advised at time of booking
Children of any age must be accompanied by an adult

Children: UNDER 24 months of age - not yet reached their 2nd birthday are welcome as a lap child at no charge when there is a minimum of two adults on board. Children 24 months and older require an individual full-fare seat. Per Federal Aviation Administration Regulation 91.205: An approved safety belt with an approved metal-to-metal latching device, or other approved restraint system for each occupant 2 years of age or older.

Passenger Weights: The safety and comfort of our passengers is very important to us. Therefore it is necessary that each passenger be asked for their height and weight. The distribution of weight is vital to safety in a helicopter and it is our responsibility to make sure that the aircraft is not overloaded or out of balance. There are also per seat weight limits for each aircraft. Total weight of all Passengers, not to exceed 600 lbs. For passengers weighing over 250 lbs. please call our office.
policies: All flights are subject to weather and air traffic control (ATC) limitations per federal aviation regulations. The pilot has the ultimate authority to determine if the weather is unsafe for flight. If your flight is cancelled due to adverse weather conditions, you can reschedule or receive a full refund

All bookings: 2 passenger minimum. For 4 or more passengers – Please note that groups will not travel at the same time. Multiple flights will need to occur. Example: 1st group flies, then 2nd group waits and so on.
It is the company's policy is to verify both credit card used to book + government issued identification. Please be prepared to have these prior to your flight.

At any given time, the federal government imposes Temporary Flight Restrictions (TFRs) which essentially closes the airspace over certain areas and prohibiting civil aircraft from flyovers. In Los Angeles, airspace is closed when VIPs such as the president are in town. Also, when Dodgers or Rams are playing, we are restricted from flying over or near these sports stadiums. We do our best to monitor TFRs and in most cases we have 24 to 48 hr. warnings. But in some cases, flight restrictions can be imposed with no warning. The LA Dodger games usually affects the Downtown LA portion of our tours.
Sunset times vary throughout the year. Please let us know if you would like sunset slot
IMPORTANT: Must have a lead contact email and mobile number. No exceptions.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Combining both city and beaches. This is a great helicopter tour if you want to see some amazing City Landmarks, including major Hollywood Studios; ‘Tinsel Town’, and the Hollywood sign with a flight above LA’s most famous and most visited beach & pier; Santa Monica!
